about: Registry of outside learning sources and what LearningApp may do with each. Checked in CI by tool/ci/verify_content_sources.py. Runbook: docs/content_intelligence/CONTENT_INGESTION_RUNBOOK.md. License readings are the maintainers' reading of the published terms, not legal advice; the owner decides each source's allowed_uses.

uses.link: Link to the source page. No text copied.
uses.reference: Name the source, edition and section as alignment or citation metadata. No text copied.
uses.quote: Copy a short excerpt verbatim, with attribution.
uses.adapt: Rewrite, remix or build on the source's text, images or exercises in our own lesson, with attribution and a note of changes.
uses.redistribute: Host a verbatim copy of a whole section or more.
uses.ai_transform: Paste the source's text into an AI chat (ours or a learner's) to produce our content. Only where adapting is allowed, and the output keeps the source's license obligations.

public_domain_us_gov.name: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. 105)
public_domain_us_gov.notes: Credit the agency anyway. Check that the page is not marked as third-party material (some government pages include copyrighted images or text).

cc_by_4.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)
cc_by_4.notes: Credit title, author, source link and license, and say what was changed.

cc_by_sa_4.name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0)
cc_by_sa_4.notes: Any lesson adapted from it must itself be published under CC BY-SA 4.0 (or a compatible license).

cc_by_nc_sa_4.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
cc_by_nc_sa_4.notes: Adapted lessons must be CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and not used primarily for commercial advantage. Whether LearningApp (with planned sponsors, affiliate links or donations) counts as non-commercial is an owner decision; until then, link and reference only.

proprietary.name: All rights reserved (proprietary)
proprietary.notes: Link to it and name sections as alignment metadata. Write our own text; never copy or paraphrase closely.

unknown.name: License not confirmed
unknown.notes: Treat as all rights reserved until the license is confirmed and recorded here.
